About the FWBA Saturday Club Ride group ride

One of the oldest clubs in North Texas. FWBA posts a Saturday ride every week, and Sundays most weeks, with the start rotating across Tarrant and nearby counties. Multiple distances and paces on each ride. Check the home page ride calendar for this week's start.
